description: Opaque dark plum-purple floor-length gown, with a low square neckline and fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and wide gold-red geometric woven ornament around the neckline, shoulder straps, waist, vertical front and skirt hem. Round decorative shoulder clasps, a narrow gold patterned waist belt and a hanging chain ornament add detail. A cream opaque underdress is visible through the lower front opening. A long cream wrap with gold-purple borders hangs along both forearms and down the sides. A small gold-purple pendant necklace and a gold-purple closed shoe are visible. No armor, head covering or weapon is present.
